context: AUTO-03 (INTENT->PLAN, SE-AUTOMATION-001F) requires converting an explicit, structured intent into a structured, auditable, deterministic, machine-readable, reproducible plan — without an LLM, without execution and without new continuity mechanisms. ADR-0021 established that 'the plan' is the implicit TASK set plus gates G2/G3, that no PLAN record type or PLAN schema exists, and that a plan-identity runtime (EPI-1) is explicitly deferred. AUTO-03 needs a machine-readable PLAN shaped from the same derivation, and an INTENT envelope to feed it.
problem: How to expose an explicit structure of the plan (and of the intent that drives it) through the CLI as READ-ONLY machine output, without introducing the PLAN record type, PLAN schema-persistence, or the EPI-1 identity runtime that ADR-0021 forbids?

options_considered.option: Persist materialized PLAN and INTENT records as a new artifact type
cons: Introduces a record lifecycle (artifact-types, templates, coverage, commands) in contradiction with ADR-0021
State drift between the plan and its sources

options_considered.option: Persist only an enveloping schema (se.intent/1 and se.plan/1) without runtime derivation
pros: Schema contracts exist and are validated
cons: No machine-readable derivation; AUTO-03 requires emitting the derived plan

options_considered.option: Define se.intent/1 and se.plan/1 as ephemeral READ-ONLY envelope contracts, derived on demand by the CLI and never persisted (AUTO-03)
pros: Matches the ADR-0021 implicit-plan model (envelope is a view over TASK records + gates G2/G3, never a record)
No new record lifecycle, no runtime, no migration
PLAN_ID/EPI-1 remains the deferred, documented identity convention of ADR-0021
cons: Envelope is recomputed each invocation (by design)
Must not be used as a persisted state container

decision: AUTO-03 introduces se.intent/1 and se.plan/1 as ephemeral, READ-ONLY envelope contracts emitted by the reference CLI and never persisted. `se intent` (CMD-0018) normalizes an explicit structured intent (from --file or --objective) into a se.intent/1 envelope (READ-ONLY, no mutation). `se plan --intent <file> --json` derives a se.plan/1 envelope from the canonical TASK set and gates G2/G3 (the implicit plan of ADR-0021): steps in deterministic topological order by dependencies, dependency edges, entry criteria from gate G2 (REQUIREMENTS READY), exit criteria from gate G3 (PLAN READY), risks/uncertainties from discovery.json, completion criterion derived deterministically, and validation against the intents/plans schemas. The PLAN is never created, updated, stored, or versioned as a record: ADR-0021 remains ACCEPTED and unchanged, and PLAN_ID/EPI-1 remains the deferred identity convention, not a runtime.
reason: The derived envelope expresses exactly the state model introduced by ADR-0021 (plan = TASK set + gates): a machine-readable projection works as a validation/decision artifact without new persistence, respects READ-ONLY/AUTO semantics, and keeps the CLI deterministic. The schema pairs (SCHEMAS/intent.schema.json, SCHEMAS/plan.schema.json) follow the existing se.auto/1 envelope pattern and are registered in SCHEMAS/index.json.
consequences: The plan envelope is recomputed on demand and is not a system-of-record (reproducibility by derivation, not storage). PLAN_ID/EPI-1 remains deferred (ADR-0021). No new artifact type, no new collection, no templates, no coverage table, no runtime identity. Any future need to persist a materialized plan requires a separate ADR (extend-before-create). Commands se intent (CMD-0018) and se plan (CMD-0006 extended with --intent/--json) become part of the 18 canonical commands and 38 adapter artifacts.
